verdict.rationale: Codex is fundamentally a natural-language driven coding agent: users delegate tasks in plain English via web, CLI, IDE, or chat integrations, and it plans, edits, and reports back (codex-docs-5,6,7; codex-gh-1). Community feedback confirms real-world NL-driven agentic use, though quality/speed/censorship complaints show inconsistent execution rather than a lack of NL command capability.
